harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key, enforced key-based-only SSH authentication (password/keyboard-interactive disabled) via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf, and verified functionally both pre- and post- a full safe reboot of node1.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: node1 boot_id, sshd status, opsadmin user absence (RHEL10 base image has no opsadmin by default)
Created opsadmin user (useradd -m), set up ~/.ssh (700) and authorized_keys (600) with the required ed25519 public key
Wrote /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf disabling PasswordAuthentication, KbdInteractiveAuthentication, ChallengeResponseAuthentication and enabling PubkeyAuthentication
Validated sshd config with sshd -t and reloaded sshd

Ran functional smoke test: generated ephemeral keypair, temporarily added to authorized_keys, confirmed pubkey SSH login succeeds and password-only SSH login is rejected, then cleaned up leaving only the required key
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy service/config state
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1 (ack captured before disconnect), polled until reachable again
Verified changed boot_id proving actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: sshd active, opsadmin user intact, authorized_keys content/permissions intact, effective sshd -T config still key-only
Repeated functional SSH smoke test post-restart confirming pubkey auth still works

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with required SSH public key installed
evidence.summary: Baseline showed no opsadmin user; follow-up command created opsadmin, installed authorized_keys with exact required key, correct 700/600 ownership/perms

evidence.requirement: SSH configured to require key-based authentication only
evidence.summary: sshd -t validated config, sshd reloaded, sshd -T confirmed effective passwordauthentication=[REDACTED], kbdinteractiveauthentication=no, pubkeyauthentication=yes

evidence.requirement: Functional proof key-based auth works and password auth is rejected (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Ephemeral keypair SSH login as opsadmin succeeded (PUBKEY_AUTH_OK); password-only SSH attempt was rejected with Permission denied (publickey...)
Captured boot_id 368725cb..., sshd active, opsadmin authorized_keys present before reboot
systemctl reboot issued; 'reboot acknowledged' line returned before the exec stream disconnected, confirming command execution before disconnection

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot (timeouts/reset), then boot_id read as 2a8ad186... differing from pre-restart 368725cb..., proving the OS actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of opsadmin config and key-only SSH policy
evidence.summary: After restart: sshd active, opsadmin present, authorized_keys content/permissions intact, sshd -T still shows password/kbd-interactive auth disabled and pubkey auth enabled

evidence.requirement: Post-restart functional proof of key-based SSH access
evidence.summary: Ephemeral keypair SSH login as opsadmin succeeded post-restart (POST_RESTART_PUBKEY_AUTH_OK), authorized_keys restored to only the required key afterward

attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key, enforced key-based-only SSH authentication (password/keyboard-interactive disabled) via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf, and verified functionally both pre- and post- a full safe reboot of node1.
